subject: rdb.c: Avoid potential file handle leak (Coverity 404720) (#12795)
reason: The change only widens a guard from `rdb_fd > 0` to `rdb_fd >= 0` when re-opening the RDB file after a successful load to queue a background close/page-cache-reclaim job. It differs from the parent only when open() returns fd 0, which requires the server's stdin to already be closed — a state the fuzzer's servers never reach — and even then the parent's only defect is one leaked descriptor and a skipped page-cache reclaim hint, with no observable effect on replies, data, persistence, replication, or crash behavior. No scenario can reach or distinguish this path, so no test is proposed.
